title: Croft Byre
shortDescription: A byre with straw, and no sheep in it.
longDescription:
The byre is warm from the croft wall and empty of sheep. Straw is kicked out, not in. A stall at the end has a hook where a bell should hang.
South is Wren. East is the wool shed's lane.

fixtures.name: Empty Stall
fixtures.lookDescription: A stall with straw kicked out. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: The straw is kicked toward the door. The hook is empty. No blood, no silk. Something the size of a sheepdog stood here long enough to warm the straw, and it was not a sheep.
